architecture_observations: ReportWorkbenchPage remains the owner of URL-backed filters, report/request state, errors/loading, server execution identity, and export recovery. Children receive props and emit semantic user intents.

loadReport increments reportRequestId and guards result application after awaits; onBeforeUnmount invalidates the id. The request itself is not aborted, so a superseded server execution may still complete and persist even though its response is ignored.

Server export uses a stable execution-scoped key `report-export:<executionId>:csv`. On known execution timeout, the page preserves the execution id in component memory and can reconcile or retry with that key.
pendingExport is held only in page memory and is cleared on reportKey change; refresh/reload does not demonstrate durable recovery of a pending export.

Filter edits do not mutate displayed server rows; `serverFiltersChanged` disables export and the status note directs the user to apply before querying/exporting, keeping displayed execution identity distinct from draft filters.

Tests exercise stale hub response suppression, switch-to-packages behavior, server snapshot alignment, timeout then artifact reconciliation, and report-specific rows/filters. They use mocks and do not prove database persistence, tenant isolation, browser download, keyboard, screen-reader, responsive, or visual behavior.
No browser screenshot, viewport matrix, keyboard/focus, screen-reader, or visual review was performed.
